name: leitner-box
description: A Persian-first desktop Leitner box with local transactional SQLite storage

scripts.test: npm run test:server && npm run test:browser
scripts.test:browser: node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning tests/browser/regression.cjs && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning tests/browser/storage.cjs && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning tests/browser/i18n.cjs
scripts.check: eslint src scripts tests/unit tests/integration tests/browser
scripts.format: prettier --write src public/*.html public/styles/*.css scripts tests/unit tests/integration tests/browser

author: imSaDy
